description: Verify that an astrology result was not altered: recompute the SHA-256 of a 'result' object returned by any tool and compare it with the result_sha256 you hold. Free.

result.description: The 'result' object exactly as a tool returned it.

result_sha256.description: The meta.result_sha256 returned with it (64 hex characters). Omit to only recompute the hash.

name: verify_result_hash

matches.description: Whether it equals the result_sha256 you sent. Absent if you sent none.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 recomputed from the 'result' you sent.

title: Verify a result hash (free)
